title: Pip
description: A handheld repair Droid, Pip was quite dear to the meknek Osha Aniseya, not to mention handy in a variety of situations. He was further customized by Osha with a variety of tools and attachments and had a cheery and chipper can-do attitude. Eager to help, he always had a suggestion for which of his tools might be the best for the task at hand.
